semantic_findings.finding: Carrier alternate and reference true-call support thresholds are a declared synthetic component. The actual Brody caller is not replayed; ancestry concordance, original-allele state, copy/LOH, recurrence, calling error and post-expansion ambiguity remain unqualified.

Known disjoint carrier/reference membership and known eligible descendants are supplied assumptions. Correct target-specific genotype calls exceed cell-stage recovery. Unknown membership is refused; the ancestry flag does not authenticate truth.

An inherited true event has one inclusion indicator, while alternate/reference call counts have separate units. Reference marginal or full carrier vector law alone does not identify the joint event-inclusion probability. An independent-reference product needs independence from the entire carrier vector.

All joint mask laws satisfying known population/design marginals are optimized. Compact simplex and full row rank ensure extrema occur at basic feasible solutions, including degenerate supports extended by zero weights. Independent exact dual certificates prove every tested endpoint without adopting producer primal-basis enumeration.

Sharp bounds condition on exact supplied marginals; they are not sample confidence intervals or finite-sample coverage. Estimated-marginal uncertainty, truth error, biochemical mutation generation and exposure/stopping/count-law admission are not supplied by this calculation.

k>=1/r>=0 are enforced; thresholds above known support are valid structural-zero cases. Positive cell-call marginals can still have zero predicate inclusion through dependence. Complete-law missing masks are declared population zeros, not conclusions from unobserved empirical masks.

All fixtures are synthetic, established finite LP is labeled established, no causal mechanism, clinical prevention, discovery or external qualified review is claimed. Actual 26-field registry and prior forecast/error/stopping contracts remain unresolved/unchanged.
